# Tarikul Islam

> Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Focused on backend engineering, full-stack web applications, cloud deployment, and AI integrations with the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Tarikul Islam builds useful digital products by connecting responsive interfaces, backend services, APIs, authentication, and data systems. His core tools include TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs. He also builds custom MCP servers and integrations for AI clients.

## Selected projects

- [Google Calendar MCP](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/google-calendar-mcp): Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server for Google Calendar, with OAuth, dynamic client registration, PKCE, per-client consent, calendar tools, and access management. [Source](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/google-calendar-mcp) · [Demo](https://google-calendar-mcp-client.vercel.app/)
- [Google Drive MCP](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/google-drive-mcp): Self-hosted Google Drive MCP server with permission-controlled access and 54 tools for Drive, Google Workspace, Office documents, and health checks. [Source](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/google-drive-mcp) · [Demo](https://googledrivemcp.vercel.app/)
- [Local Filesystem MCP](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/local-filesystem-mcp): Self-hosted MCP server for controlled local file and directory operations, uploads, filesystem inspection, screenshots, command execution, and Chromium automation. [Source](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/local-filesystem-mcp)
- [Portfolio](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/portfolio): Responsive personal portfolio presenting selected work, experience, and technical interests. [Source](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/Portfolio)
- [ClassFlow Prime](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/classflow-prime): Education workspace for class updates, schedules, exams, groups, and member coordination. [Source](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/classflow-prime) · [Demo](https://classflow-prime.vercel.app/)
- [DeenSeries](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/deenseries): Streaming platform for Islamic movies and series, with administration tools for titles and episodes. [Source](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/DeenSeries) · [Demo](https://deenseries.vercel.app/)
- [Mosque Management System](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/mosque-management-system): Community administration platform for family records, contributions, payments, donations, expenses, committee work, and public information. [Frontend](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/mosque-management-frontend) · [Backend](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/mosque-management-backend) · [Demo](https://mosque-management-systems.vercel.app/)
- [Bishuddho Academy](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/bishuddho-academy): EdTech platform connecting course discovery and enrollment with student and administration workflows. [Client](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/bishuddho-academy-client) · [Server](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/bishuddho-academy-server) · [Demo](https://bishuddho-academy.vercel.app/)

## Services

- Full-stack web application development with React, Next.js, backend services, authentication, and database integration.
- Backend and REST API development with Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.
- Cloud deployment and application integration, including Vercel deployments and environment configuration.
- AI integration and custom MCP server development for external APIs, Google Calendar, local file-system tools, and AI-assisted workflows.

## Technology focus

TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Vercel, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Git, GitHub, and Docker.
